tickets.title: Obtain term policy carrier information
tickets.text: Obtain carrier information on Arlo Copperwisp’s term life policy reinstatement terms, catch‑up premium, conversion availability, and underwriting requirements from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain that carrier information by March 1, 2024.

tickets.title: Process recurring payment change request
tickets.text: Update the authorized recurring insurance premium drafts for Arlo Copperwisp’s policies to draw from the Teacup Comet Bank operating account instead of the closed Pocket Lantern Bank account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to update the payment source by February 29, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain current insurance declaration pages
tickets.text: Obtain current home, auto, umbrella, and rental property insurance declaration pages for Arlo and Lena Copperwisp from the respective carriers to confirm coverage limits.
tickets.evidence: Current declarations are needed by March 8, 2024.

tickets.title: Review rental condo protection coverage
tickets.text: Review the insurance protection for the Bend rental condo, including landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss‑of‑rent exposures for the Copperwisp household.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review that protection by March 15, 2024.

tickets.title: Compare employer benefits elections with private coverage
tickets.text: Compare Arlo Copperwisp’s employer‑provided supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary elections with his private coverage to identify gaps before the benefits portal closes.
tickets.evidence: That comparison is needed by March 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Gather life insurance beneficiary evidence
tickets.text: Gather current beneficiary evidence from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance to resolve the discrepancy with the beneficiary summary in the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file.
tickets.evidence: That evidence is needed by March 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Arlo Copperwisp’s current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. The advisory review noted the estate binder lacks trust funding evidence and may have outdated fiduciary role information.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow‑up items for the lead advisor before any client‑facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.
